evidence.quote: The dog-bone samples were sealed in an evacuated quartz tube with 0.005 Torr vacuum using a vacuum sealing machine system (MRVS200, China). The sealed samples were annealed at 1200°C temperature for 45 min to get recrystallized microstructures using a box-type resistance furnace (SGM M11/17AE, China).

Local lattice distortion plays a key role in solid solution strengthening, which is induced by atomic size mismatch and electronegativity difference of multiple elements.
Their super formability stems from the movability of <111>/2-type dislocations.
